reader_notes: Long LAS unit. Swedish is idiomatic and consistently held in a kulturskribent register; period vocabulary (dagsverksbok, bom, ledarm, stenkista, bomarke, skiljestalle) is used correctly and the three glossed terms are the ones a student would actually need.

Figures are internally consistent across the whole text: 'nara varannan noterad arbetsdag' in the opening matches 'efterrensningen tar nara halften' in paragraph 4; brotar are 'knappt sju procent'; vantan is 'var tionde dagsnotering', which is what makes the 'en tredjedel' foil in q4 cleanly wrong.

The text is careful about its own limits (var sjatte notering unclassifiable, five leder show nothing, Ronnan runs the other way, the 1938 bookkeeping-change objection is conceded and re-run), and q4's key depends on the student honouring that hedging rather than over-reading the finding.
q1 option C is a good trap because it is the same finding stripped of its scope condition; the passage explicitly says no difference could be shown on the steep upper stretches.
